name: Sámi and Finno-Ugric peoples of the north
summary: The Sámi of northern Scandinavia and the Finno-Ugric peoples of the northern forests, such as the Khanty, Mansi and Komi, who lived by hunting, fishing and reindeer herding.

knownFor.label: Joik
knownFor.note: A Sámi song form that “sings” a person, animal or place.

knownFor.label: Reindeer herding
knownFor.note: Herding reindeer for meat, milk, hides and transport.
